title: PrimaLuce LED setter accepts nested command refusal as success
summary: primalucelib_set_leds returns request transport/verb success without inspecting nested DIMLEDS acknowledgement. ALTO X_LEDS memoizes the requested switch and reports OK when the simulator returns Error: invalid command. A targeted rejection variant of the existing LED test reproduced missing ALERT; retained in led-nested-ack-baseline.txt. Shared GIOTTO/focuser consumers use this helper too. Scope remains separate from requested AP finding fa40-011 and simulator atomicity fa40-014. Next: coordinator assigns focused acknowledgement validation and regression.
